title: [Game Window] get_global_mouse_position() return wrong value when using override in-game camera
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in 4.4.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon HD 5570 (0x000068D9) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-8.17.10.1404) - Intel(R) Pentium(R) CPU G2030 @ 3.00GHz (2 threads)

### Issue description

When using override in the in-game camera in the Game window to change the camera position, the `get_global_mouse_position()` returns the wrong value
default viewport:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d83545a0-bd08-4945-80f0-8c074f169dc8

with my camera:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bfb9e396-5a64-4d58-8b36-70366cc8301f

Using override in the in-game camera:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83b97ab5-a4fb-4eb1-b43b-e3d4fc0f4a4e

As u can see, this will break the code functionality 

### Steps to reproduce

A:
1. Run MRP

B:
1. Create an empty scene
2. Add a node 2d
3. Add the Godot icon to the scene
4. attach a script to node 2d
5. Write script
```gdscript
extends Node2D

@onready var icon: Sprite2D = $Icon

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("click"):
		icon.position = get_global_mouse_position()
```
6. Add camera 2d in the scene and change the camera position to your favorite 
7. Test the project
8. Use override in-game camera now
9. Check the result

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_2025-03-31_00-11-49.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19531036/test_2025-03-31_00-11-49.zip)
